mfa_not_registered.title: Register multi-factor authentication
mfa_not_registered.plain_language: Some people have not set up an extra sign-in check.
mfa_not_registered.immediate_action: Ask affected users, especially administrators, to register an authenticator app or approved method today.
mfa_not_registered.long_term_action: Require registration for all users, track completion, and provide onboarding and recovery support.

mfa_not_enforced.title: Require multi-factor authentication
mfa_not_enforced.plain_language: Users may have a method available, but the sign-in rules do not require it.
mfa_not_enforced.immediate_action: Review the affected access rule and require an extra identity check for the relevant users and services.
mfa_not_enforced.long_term_action: Use tested access policies with monitoring, emergency-account controls, and regular reviews.

legacy_auth_allowed.title: Block older sign-ins
legacy_auth_allowed.plain_language: Older connection methods may bypass modern protection.
legacy_auth_allowed.immediate_action: Find affected apps and users, update them, and block older sign-ins where possible.
legacy_auth_allowed.long_term_action: Keep legacy methods disabled and monitor for new attempts.

ca_policy_report_only.title: Move policy from report-only to enforced
ca_policy_report_only.plain_language: The rule is watching sign-ins but not protecting them yet.
ca_policy_report_only.immediate_action: Review simulated results, fix unwanted exclusions, and plan an enablement window.
ca_policy_report_only.long_term_action: Use pilot groups, change control, and ongoing sign-in monitoring.

ca_policy_disabled.title: Enable the access policy
ca_policy_disabled.plain_language: The rule is switched off and provides no protection.
ca_policy_disabled.immediate_action: Confirm its scope, test it safely, and enable it as soon as practical.
ca_policy_disabled.long_term_action: Review policies regularly and document owners, exceptions, and emergency access.

risky_user_detected.title: Investigate the risky account
risky_user_detected.plain_language: An account shows signs that someone unauthorized may be using it.
risky_user_detected.immediate_action: Verify the person, reset the password, require multi-factor authentication, and review recent activity.
risky_user_detected.long_term_action: Configure risk-based access rules and a documented incident response process.

admin_without_mfa.title: Protect the administrator account
admin_without_mfa.plain_language: A powerful administrator account lacks an extra sign-in check.
admin_without_mfa.immediate_action: Have the administrator register multi-factor authentication immediately and review recent sign-ins.
admin_without_mfa.long_term_action: Use separate admin accounts, least privilege, time-limited elevation, and mandatory strong authentication.
